teaching.hint: What must be true both locally at each child and globally across all nodes?

solution_outline.decisive_insight: A single rooted tree requires one parent per nonroot, one root, and reachability of every node from that root.
solution_outline.approach: Count incoming child links and reject any node with multiple parents. Require exactly one zero-indegree root, then traverse its child links and require all `n` nodes visited.
solution_outline.state_and_invariant: After the local checks, each nonroot has one parent and the root has none. The traversal count records whether every supplied node belongs to that rooted structure.
solution_outline.correctness: A valid tree passes all checks. Conversely, if every node is reached from the sole root and no child has two parents, the reachable structure has exactly `n-1` links and cannot contain a cycle or disconnected component.
solution_outline.pitfall: A unique root and valid indegrees do not exclude a separate directed cycle.

common_wrong_turns: Checking only for a unique root
source_fidelity_notes: Removed diagram-based examples; retained child direction, `-1` semantics, and exact-one-tree requirement.
